purpose: Papers and reports whose machines the replicate-paper skill rebuilds in FEMM. The development set builds and improves the skill; the held-out set measures it with the skill frozen. Each replicated paper has a case file under data/papers/.
selection: Chosen on 2026-10-25 for openly readable full text, geometry complete enough to draw, published numbers usable as frozen targets, FEMM 2D feasibility and spread across machine families. Access and gaps were checked by reading each full text.

papers.title: Experimental verification of optimal flux weakening in surface PM machines using concentrated windings
papers.citation: A. M. El-Refaie, T. M. Jahns, P. J. McCleer, J. W. McKeever, IEEE Trans. Industry Applications 42(2), 2006
papers.machine: 6 kW 36-slot 30-pole inner-rotor surface PM, fractional-slot concentrated winding, bonded NdFeB
papers.teaches: The workflow itself on existing components (slotted stator, star-of-slots winding, arc magnets); inductance extraction.
papers.known_gaps: Steel grade and B-H curve; tooth-tip wedge; as-built magnet taper.
papers.targets: Analytic flux linkage and inductance (tables), 2D FEA and measured inductance (text), measured flux linkage and back-EMF (plots).

papers.citation: J. Wang, D. Howe, IEEE Trans. Magnetics 41(9), 2005, pp. 2470-2478; Part II pp. 2479-2489
papers.machine: Three-phase moving-magnet tubular linear machine with quasi-Halbach magnets; slotless analysis case and a 10-pole 9-slot prototype
papers.teaches: Axisymmetric problems, Halbach magnet arrays, air-gap field harmonics, linear motion.
papers.known_gaps: Part II prototype tooth width, slot depth, yoke, B-H curves.
papers.targets: Part I: analytic radial-field harmonics (table). Part II: measured, analytic and FE inductance (table).
papers.topic: Quasi-Halbach magnetized tubular modular PM machines, Part I (magnetic field, EMF and thrust)

papers.title: Accurate magnetic characterization based model development for switched reluctance machine
papers.citation: M. Hamouda, L. Számel, Periodica Polytechnica Electrical Engineering and Computer Science 63(3), 2019, pp. 202-212, doi:10.3311/PPee.14012
papers.teaches: Salient-pole stator and rotor components; flux linkage against current and position; reading targets from plots with stated uncertainty.
papers.known_gaps: Slot and coil outline; pole side shape; series or parallel coil connection.
papers.targets: Measured and FEMM flux linkage, inductance and static torque (plots).

papers.title: TEAM workshop problem 30: induction motor analyses
papers.citation: Compumag TEAM problem 30, with K. Davey's analytic solution
papers.machine: Two-pole solid-rotor induction motor (steel core in an aluminium shell), three-phase and single-phase variants
papers.teaches: Time-harmonic eddy currents, torque and losses from AC solutions, how slip and space harmonics map onto single-frequency solves.
papers.known_gaps: Whether the 310 A/cm2 current density is rms (a vendor verification model treats it as rms).
papers.targets: Analytic torque, voltage and loss tables against rotor speed; field tables at 200 rad/s.

papers.machine: 48-slot 8-pole interior PM with V and bar magnets, hairpin winding, 53 kW
papers.teaches: Interior magnet pockets, d/q current-angle sweeps, intake of supplementary geometry and B-H files.
papers.known_gaps: Slot and pocket dimensions are in supplementary vector files (download needs the user's approval); magnet grade inferred by the authors.
papers.targets: 2D FEA PM flux linkage and d/q inductances; measured torque against current angle (plot).

papers.title: Simple design approach for low torque ripple and high output torque synchronous reluctance motors
papers.citation: M. N. Ibrahim, P. Sergeant, E. M. Rashad, Energies 9(11):942, 2016
papers.machine: 36-slot 4-pole synchronous reluctance prototype with three flux barriers per pole
papers.teaches: Flux-barrier rotors; documented assumptions with sensitivity controls for missing ribs and steel data.
papers.known_gaps: Tangential rib width, barrier-end radius, slot depth (from the stated slot area), M400-50A B-H data.
papers.targets: 2D FEM torque and ripple (table); measured and FEM d/q inductances and torque against current angle (plots).

papers.title: Evaluation of 2004 Toyota Prius hybrid electric drive system
papers.citation: Oak Ridge National Laboratory report ORNL/TM-2006/423, with the lamination drawing in ORNL/TM-2005/33 and dimensions in ORNL/TM-2010/253
papers.teaches: Held out: interior-PM transfer, geometry from a scaled drawing, conflicting sources, measured targets.
papers.known_gaps: Pocket and bridge dimensions (to be scaled from the drawing), steel and magnet grades, coil span; air gap 0.73 mm stated against 0.77 mm from the drawing.
papers.targets: Measured torque against rotor angle at 50-250 A and back-EMF against speed (tables).

papers.citation: M. Przybylski, Archives of Electrical Engineering 71(1), 2022, pp. 125-138, doi:10.24425/aee.2022.140201, with AEE 68(2), 2019, pp. 443-454, doi:10.24425/aee.2019.128279
papers.teaches: Held out: switched-reluctance transfer, merging two papers, a B-H curve read from a figure.
papers.known_gaps: Exact slot shape (area only), tabulated B-H curve, steel grade; the winding was rewired between the papers.
papers.targets: Measured and FEMM static torque (table); aligned and unaligned inductance (table).
papers.topic: Static characteristics of a 12/8 switched reluctance motor, measured and computed in FEMM

papers.citation: Milykh, Electrical Engineering & Electromechanics 2026 no. 1, pp. 3-14, doi:10.20998/2074-272X.2026.1.01, with 2023 no. 4, pp. 3-13
papers.machine: 15 kW 4-pole 48/38-slot squirrel-cage induction motor with closed rotor slots
papers.teaches: Held out: induction transfer from a solid rotor to a cage rotor, sparse B-H data.
papers.known_gaps: B-H below 1.54 T, shaft diameter, end-ring geometry, explicit phase-belt layout.
papers.targets: The author's FEMM no-load flux and EMF and rated torque (tables).
papers.topic: 15 kW four-pole squirrel-cage induction motor analysed in FEMM

papers.title: Torque calculation and dynamical response in Halbach array coaxial magnetic gears through a novel analytical 2D model
papers.machine: Coaxial magnetic gear, 4 inner and 10 outer pole pairs, iron modulator ring, radial or Halbach inner rotor
papers.teaches: Held out: a topology the development set never covers (flux modulation, two rotors).
papers.known_gaps: Magnet relative permeability; iron modelled as infinitely permeable.
papers.targets: Analytic torque amplitudes (table); FEA agreement reported as 1-1.5%.

papers.citation: D. Ishak, Z. Q. Zhu, D. Howe, IEEE Trans. Industry Applications 41(2), 2005, with IEEE Trans. Magnetics 41(9), 2005
papers.machine: Three 12-slot 10-pole stators on one surface-PM rotor
papers.known_gaps: Shoe height and slot profile, magnet relative permeability, steel grade.
papers.targets: Measured and FE inductances (table); measured EMF and torque (plots).
papers.topic: 12-slot 10-pole surface PM machines with all and alternate teeth wound

papers.machine: 72-slot 12-pole interior PM with two magnet layers
papers.known_gaps: Rotor geometry reconstructed by the authors from a photograph, not tabulated.
papers.targets: 2D FEA d/q flux linkage and torque on a current grid (tables).

papers.title: Investigation of short permanent magnet and stator flux bridges effects on cogging torque mitigation in FSPM machines
papers.citation: C. Gan et al., IEEE Trans. Energy Conversion 33(2), 2018, pp. 845-855
papers.known_gaps: Magnet grade and remanence, steel, rotor pole depth.
papers.targets: Measured and 2D FEM peak cogging and mean torque (text).

papers.title: Performance analysis and experimental validation of outer-rotor PMSMs for drone propulsion systems
papers.machine: Two 40-pole 36-slot outer-rotor concentrated-winding surface PM motors
papers.teaches: Alternate: outer rotor with measured tables.
papers.known_gaps: Slot-opening and slot-span angles, magnet arc, grade and relative permeability.
papers.targets: Measured back-EMF at three speeds and 2D FEM flux linkage and inductance (tables).

note: Entries with a topic instead of a title have not had their exact title checked; the citation identifies the paper.
